notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: Purchase of 19 Mac Studio Computers, Displays, & AppleCare
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded KNZ Solutions Inc. a $152,405 contract to buy 19 Mac Studio computers, displays and AppleCare coverage, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business without competition.

notices.short_title: Replacement of the existing air handling units

The Employees' Retirement System awarded Pitney Bowes, Inc. an $86,128 contract for mailroom postage meter machines, chosen through a purchase from another government's contract.

notices.short_title: POLECAM-2025 For the Purchase of Envirosight QuickView Air HD Zoom Camera System and Accessories

The Department of Environmental Protection intends to award a contract for centrifuge parts, with responses to the request for information due March 13, 2026.
The Department of Finance has renewed its maintenance contract with Vision Government Solutions, Inc., for CAMA Software 8.0 at $4.8 million.

notices.short_title: FY27 Renewal - FWC Shelter Flagstone Family Center 161 units

notices.short_title: Design and Development Training Course for TLC Drivers

The Department of Transportation awarded 3G Warehouse, Inc. a $900,000 contract for warehousing and distribution services through a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business, made without competition.
